source_of_truth: Written from the scaffold. Both files start with `<!-- @ds-ejected from=... version=... sha256=... -->`. AppTooltip.vue's hash is `shasum -a 256` of the exact bytes that follow the marker line, so it is not drifted. AppToast.vue's hash was computed over the original body, after which the body was re-indented (two leading spaces → four) and a blank line was appended; the marker was NOT refreshed. The contract defines drifted as sha256 of the body ≠ the marker's hash and hashes bytes, not normalised text, so a whitespace-only edit is a drift (confirmed). Both files have a one-line HTML doc comment immediately after the marker and both are exported from index.ts, so neither is undocumented. Both declare props (and AppToast an emit), so neither is a pass-through.

expected.rationale: marker sha256 is over the pre-edit body; the on-disk body differs in bytes (indentation and a trailing blank line), and the contract treats any byte difference as drift

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the marker's sha256 equals the sha256 of the file without the marker line, computed in the scaffold exactly as the contract defines it
